page.title: Swihlanganisi
page.intro: Hlanganisa tiakhawunti ta wena ta swinavetiso. Ti leads kusuka eka swinavetiso swa wena ti fika eka My Leads hiku tisungulela, na spend na cost hi lead.

connect.title: Hlanganisa LinkedIn
connect.intro: Nghena hi akhawunti ya LinkedIn leyi lawulaka swinavetiso swa wena. Leadrat yi hlaya ntsena tiakhawunti ta wena ta swinavetiso, swiletelo swa Lead Gen Form na tinhlayo ta swinavetiso, naswona yi rhumela ku hundzuka loku u ku pfulaka.
connect.need1: Xiphemu eka akhawunti ya swinavetiso LinkedIn (Mulanguti kumbe ku tlula).
connect.need2: Ntirho eka tluka ra khamphani leyi hlanganisiweke (Mulawuri, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator kumbe Analyst) - LinkedIn yi lava leswaku yi avelana swiletelo.
connect.need3: Xivutiso xa nomboro ya riqingho eka Lead Gen Forms - swiletelo leswi nga riki na nomboro ya riqingho a swi nge engeteriwi.

connection.confirmDisconnect: Ku tsema vuhlanganisi LinkedIn ? Ku fambisana ka yima naswona swikombiso swa mfikelelo swa susiwa. Swiletelo, tinhlayo na log ya migingiriko swa hlayisiwa.
connection.noPermission: U nga languta tluka leri. Ku hlanganisa na ku cinca swiletelo swi lava mpfumelelo wa "Lawula Switirhisiwa".
connection.fetchTitle: Languta swiletelo hi ku ya hi nxaxamelo wa masiku
connection.fetchHint: Ti leads tintshwa ti kamberiwa endzhaku ka timinete tin’wana na tin’wana naswona masiku ya 7 yo hetelela ya kamberiwa nakambe siku na siku, kutani a ku na nchumu lowu hundzeriweke hi nkarhi. Tirhisa leswi eka ti leads kusuka loko unga se hlanganisa, kumbe ku kambela nkarhi nakambe (kufika eka 90 wa masiku hi nkarhi). Ti leads leti se ti nga eka Leadrat ti skipiwile.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} ku kumiwile, {{created}} ku tumbuluxiwile, {{duplicates}} ku phindha, {{rejected}} ku ariwile, {{skipped}} se ku nghenisiwile.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Byela LinkedIn leswaku hi wihi eka swiletelo swa yona leswi veke switshembiso swa xiviri. Loko lead ya LinkedIn yi fikelela xiyimo lexi u xi hlawulaka laha hansi, Leadrat yi swi vika eka LinkedIn , kutani swiviko swa wena swa pfhumba swi kombisa khwalithi ya lead naswona LinkedIn yi nga kuma vanhu vo tala ku fana na leads ya wena ya kahle. Ku rhumeriwa ntsena ID ya lead ya LinkedIn na hash ya ndlela yin’we ya email.
capi.rules: Ku endliwa ka mepe wa xiyimo
capi.noRules: Ku hava swiyimo leswi mepiweke ku fikela sweswi.
capi.created: Ku hundzuka ku endliwile eka LinkedIn naswona ku endliwile mepe.

activity.title: Log ya migingiriko
activity.intro: Hinkwaswo exikarhi ka Leadrat na LinkedIn : vuhlanganisi, ku fambisana kun’wana na kun’wana, lead yin’wana na yin’wana na leswi humeleleke eka yona, ku hundzuka na swihoxo.
activity.empty: Ku hava ntirho ku fikela sweswi.
